title: The End of Tyrants and Beginning of Sultanate
body:
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Allahuma yansuru! They strayed from the path, they went too far. They strayed
from keeping divine orders, which is why it was sent upon them. Allah does not send (an affliction) upon
anyone without a reason, and so much has befallen them! (...)
He shouldn't wait; let him come. Amna ’l-amaan, there is safety in Sham. On a tasbeeh, you can see that all
beads are strung together. If you cut the string, they will fall off one by one. Similarly, these tyrants were all
connected to each other, but he snapped it from one side and now all of them will fall off and there is no way
to be strung another time, no. People, particularly Muslims, have learned their lesson that if they bring to
power similar (disobedient) ones again, their punishment will double. After this, they will bring their kings,
the sultans, and Mahdi (a) will accept them, as Grandshaykh (q) said, "Sultans will be the ministers of Mahdi
(a).”
There is one sultan who will rule over the whole Muslim world as the khalifah of Mahdi (a). All other sultans
will be in Turkey, Sham, Iraq, Egypt, Libya, Tunis, Jazaa’ir (Algeria), Pakistan... but Pakistanis are different.
All will be under the rule of their own sultans, who will take permission from Mahdi (a) and move forward by
his command. I am waiting for Sham now, their main castle. When Sham falls, they (oppressors) will all fall!

Hajjah Naziha: Inshaa-Allah. We are reciting, “HasbunAllah, RabbunAllah” everyday 100-1000 times.
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: You are doing well. (Du`a)
•••• ••• •••• •••
Awwalahu sham aakhirahu sham, “The beginning of it is Sham and the end of it is Sham.”
Visitor: How can such a great power as the Ottomans end up being like this (present-day Turkey)?
Mawlana Shaykh Nazim: Because the time and Hour has approached. Inna Hu Hameedun Majeed! In
Topkapi Palace, when you enter there is a kitabe, stone panel, with all Ottoman sultans' names inscribed.
When the sultan went through the entrance, first he looked toward it (to show respect) and then entered. Its
inscription begins with the name of Osman Gazi Sultan, and the name of each Ottoman sultan is inscribed.
Sultan Abdul Hamid’s name was the last one to fill up the remaining space. When it was Sultan Reshad’s
term to rule, our majestic sultan, they told him, "There is no more space left for your name." Sultan Reshad
cried and said, "Then have them make a another one next to it." And in reality, Sultan Resshad was the only
sultan who ruled under a constitutional monarchy system; therefore, his rule was not taken into
consideration. He was excluded, and that was the end of the sultanate period.
(Prophet said) “After them, a time will come for the advent of jabaabira, tyrants,” the results of which we now
see in Turkey, Russia (Stalin), Germany (Hitler), and finally it spread among the Arabs. All of them
dethroned the sultans, which is to deny Allah Almighty, as sultans move in accordance with Qur'an `azeemu
’sh-shaan! These tyrants are all shaytaans who do not accept Qur’an al-Kareem and they are referred to as
“the People of Hellfire.”
There is not a single act of outrage they haven't carried out. In this regard, leaders of Turks, Persians, Iraqis,
Egyptians, Libyans and Hijazis are all the same: none of them implemented the law Islam came with and they
all invented things according to their minds, saying, "By all means, we must be like western countries!"
following ‘westernization.’
This is what they want and why they went after them, but when they did they became zero. Now people of the
ummah are consuming one another. Why? Because they moved against the orders of Allah (swt) and his

Messenger (s)! He said, “Now they will intervene and will want to remove Qur’an al-Kareem. They will
remove caliphate, sultanate, and Shari`ah, replacing them with the fabricated dirt of Shaytan! Therefore, all
of them have plunged into the dirt of Shaytan: Egyptians, Libyans, Turks, Persians are all in it. They will not
be eliminated until Mahdi (a) comes.”
Now time is very short. May Allah forgive us.
Fatihah.
They call it batililasma, "to be westernized," but in reality it is baatillasma, "to assimilate falsehood.' They
have left haqq and are worshiping baatil, falsehood. There! They got what they deserved, first the Turks, then
all others. May Allah keep us from being of them. We are not those who accept baatil, falsehood!
Fatihah.
Lefke, 04.05.2011 (Translated from Turkish)
